client_decisions: Create one original brutalist civic plaza at dusk.
Use the supplied reference only for abstract colour relationships and subtle material texture.
Do not inherit the reference composition, subject matter, typography, branding, icons, or ornamental motifs.
locked_items: Time and mood: dusk / blue hour
Reference influence boundary: colour palette and material texture only
No text, logos, product imagery, or decorative motifs
changed_items: Introduced an original wide, pedestrian-eye-level plaza composition.
Created monumental rectilinear civic massing with portals, terraces, stairs, ramps, and an open forecourt.
Added dispersed pedestrians to establish scale and public use.
Translated the reference's warm bone/oatmeal, taupe, and charcoal relationships into dusk-lit concrete architecture.
Translated the reference's fine matte grain into subtle sandblasted concrete and mineral paving texture.
